name: Head of the Obliterator
summary: You find the head of a massive war golem, still in remarkably good shape. Its size suggests the assembled machine would tower over the others nearby.

sections.title: A Golem's Head
sections.body: Other parts may lie nearby. The head belongs to a massive war golem, and it remains remarkably well preserved. Fully assembled, the machine would tower over the others you have seen here.

faq.answer: You found the head of a massive war golem in remarkably good shape.
Fully assembled, it would tower over the other golems you have seen here.

attribution: In-game quest text: Head of the Obliterator
